lines.text: Leo hikes down to the 3 Mile Resthouse, planning to refill his bottle.
On the Bright Angel Trail, water runs from May through October,
and it can shut off any time a pipe breaks.
Here's the fix. Carry all the water you need from the rim, plus salty snacks,
and ask at the visitor center about water that morning.
Now Leo carries his own water and climbs out strong.
Save this before your canyon trip.
